integrity: Finite verification is corroboration; infinite assertions follow from a four-state weighted carry recursion and formal rational generating-function identity. This is self-review only, not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: All-binomial valuation distribution is proved for the dyadic cutoffs 0 <= n < 2^k and prime 2 only; not arbitrary cutoffs, primes or binomial diagonals. Known parity and valuation-two layers and the normal limit are not asserted original. An unindexed equivalent exact formula remains possible.
title: Exact dyadic valuation distribution of \(\binom{3n}{n}\)
